mentions.name: CodinIT.dev
mentions.description: A local-first, open-source AI full-stack app builder that turns natural-language prompts into prototype-to-production web apps. It supports local and self-hosted workflows, connects to databases such as Supabase, includes an integrated terminal and git automation, and plugs into 19+ AI providers for fast iteration. Positioned as a local open-source alternative to bolt, lovable, and v0.
mentions.problem: Closed AI app builders leave developers without full control of their code and lock them into vendors.
mentions.audience: Indie hackers who want full control of their code without vendor lock-ins
mentions.source_excerpt: TL;DR: CodinIT.dev is a local-first, open-source AI full-stack app builder that turns natural-language prompts into prototype → production web apps.
